tool.name: cms_healthcare_provider_search
tool.title: CMS Healthcare Provider Search
tool.description:
Search official CMS Provider Data Catalog directories for Medicare-certified hospitals, nursing homes, home health agencies, hospices, dialysis facilities, long-term care hospitals, and inpatient rehab facilities. Returns normalized facility records (identity, ownership, capacity, and star ratings) across all seven provider types through one consistent row shape.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/cms-healthcare-provider-search'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; queries the public CMS Provider Data Catalog API, no API key or login required.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 10-30 seconds; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for healthcare facility due diligence, star-rating and quality comparisons, nursing-home staffing/inspection/fines research, or building a location-bounded list of Medicare-certified providers.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for clinical trial recruitment data, environmental compliance, campaign finance, corporate registry lookups, or contractor licensing.
- Named alternatives: Use 'clinical_trials_search' for ClinicalTrials.gov study data, 'epa_facility_search' for environmental compliance, 'us_business_entity_search' or 'us_contractor_license_search' for corporate/contractor registries, or 'europe_pmc_paper_search' for biomedical literature.

provider_types.description: One or more CMS provider-directory types to search, e.g. ['hospital'] or ['nursing_home', 'hospice']. Omit to search hospitals only, the Actor's own fallback.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation to search within, e.g. 'TX'.

city.description: City name to filter by, matched exactly (case-insensitive, not a substring), e.g. 'Houston'.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code to filter by, e.g. '77030'.

county.description: County name to filter by, matched exactly (case-insensitive), e.g. 'Harris'.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the provider or facility name, e.g. 'Memorial'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of provider records to retrieve and bill. Defaults to 10.

results.description: Collection of normalized Medicare-certified provider records matching the search.

provider_type.description: Which CMS directory this row came from (hospital, nursing_home, home_health, hospice, dialysis, long_term_care_hospital, or inpatient_rehab).

ccn.description: CMS Certification Number, the stable identifier for the provider (hospitals use their facility ID here).

name.description: Facility or provider name as published by CMS.

address.description: Public street address reported by CMS.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code reported for the record.

phone.description: Public provider telephone number in CMS display format.

ownership.description: Ownership or profit status as classified by CMS for this directory.

subtype.description: Directory-specific subtype, e.g. hospital type for hospitals or provider type for nursing homes.

star_rating.description: CMS overall one-to-five star rating for the provider, when the directory publishes one.

certification_date.description: Date CMS certified the provider, in YYYY-MM-DD form where available.

beds.description: Number of certified beds. Nursing homes and long-term care hospitals only.

chain.description: Chain or corporate ownership group name, when CMS reports one. Nursing homes and dialysis facilities only.

emergency_services.description: Whether the hospital reports emergency services ('Yes'/'No'). Hospitals only.

readme_row: | **CMS Healthcare Provider Search** | [`captainhandsome/cms-healthcare-provider-search`](https://apify.com/captainhandsome/cms-healthcare-provider-search) | name, provider_type, city, state, star_rating | Compare CMS-certified hospitals, nursing homes, and other Medicare providers by location, ownership, and star rating. |
filter_audit: provider_types (filter; schema default ['hospital']): main.py does `kinds = inp.get('provider_types') or ['hospital']`, so a missing or null value is tolerated and falls back to hospital only. state (filter; schema prefill and default 'CA'): conditions() only appends the state condition when `inp.get('state')` is truthy, so a missing or null value is tolerated and simply omits the state filter (the 'CA' prefill only pre-populates the Apify Console UI form; it is not applied to API calls that omit the key). city, zip, county, and name_contains carry no prefill or default. max_items defaults to 10 but is a result-count cap, not a narrowing filter.
